Fixes the crash reported in incident 42 and closes #218.

What happened

The exporter assumed every row has a completed_at timestamp. Rows still in flight have null, so the batch aborted partway through and the dashboard showed stale numbers overnight.

The fix

  • Treat completed_at as optional and fall back to started_at for ordering.
  • Emit a row_skipped metric instead of aborting the whole batch.
  • Added a regression test covering the in-flight row shape.

The first commit shows the failing test before the fix.
Deployed to staging this morning — the backlog drained in ~40s and no rows were skipped unexpectedly.
